headings.usage: Used for all page titles, section headers, and prominent metric numbers. Brings a sense of reverence, tradition, and warmth.

body.usage: Used for all UI elements, forms, feed content, and admin tables. Provides modern, clean legibility.

rules: H1 size max text-4xl to text-5xl with tracking-tight.
Use tracking-[0.2em] uppercase for overlines/labels (e.g., 'MURAL DE ORAÇÃO').
Maintain a 2-step tailwind scale gap between headings and subheadings.

colors.philosophy: Conveys trust, spiritual growth, and calm. Avoids clinical 'SaaS blue'.
rules: Use accent color (#C06E52) strictly for emotional triggers like the 'Orando por você' button.
Tint all neutral grays with a hint of warm orange/yellow to match the background.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid backgrounds. Avoid glassmorphism to keep the UI grounded and accessible.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for floating elements (like dropdowns). Feed cards should rely on borders, not shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for main content cards (feed items), rounded-full for buttons and pills.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the main background can add a tactile, paper-like feel.

grids_and_layouts.global: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, or p-12 for container paddings.
grids_and_layouts.feed_pages: Progressive disclosure layout. Main canvas for the feed (col-span-12 md:col-span-8), with a sticky right rail for highlights, filters, or 'Upcoming Events' (md:col-span-4). gap-8.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid. Tight gaps (gap-4). Cardless, rectangular, dense styles using Shadcn tables.
grids_and_layouts.agenda: Bento Grid style for events. Emphasize the date using large typography (e.g., Day in H2, Month in overline).
grids_and_layouts.auth_page: Split screen. 50% image with bg-black/20 overlay, 50% minimalist login form centered.

components.prayer_feed_card: Cardless or subtle border. Author at top, bold text for request, bottom action bar with '🙏 Orando por você' button (changes to solid accent color when clicked) and counter.
components.event_card: Visual tension. Left side contains large date (e.g., '24 Out'), right side contains title, time, and location.
components.contribution_section: Split view. Left: PIX QR Code and bank details with a prominent 'Copiar Chave' button. Right: Form to log the contribution for admin review.
components.navigation: Solid background (#FFFFFF) top bar or sidebar. No transparent headers. Clearly visible links.

motion.interactions: Hover states must have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and color shift. Focus states must have a 2px ring of primary color.
motion.feed_load: Staggered fade-in (opacity and slight Y translation) for feed items to make it feel organic.
motion.buttons: Active (click) state should scale down slightly (scale-95) for tactile feedback.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio against #F9F8F6.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all inputs and buttons. Never rely on color alone.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='login-btn', data-testid='pray-btn', data-testid='copy-pix-btn').

icons.usage: Use icons sparingly. Prefer text labels. Use icons for actions like copy, edit, delete, and the prayer hands.

auth_background.description: Gathered in prayer at a modern indoor church setting. Use as full height background on the login/register split screen.

prayer_wall_header.description: Close up of person holding hands together. Use as a subtle banner or hero image for the Prayer Wall.

testimony_wall_header.description: Tree against golden sun. Use as a hopeful, bright banner for the Testimony Wall.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application exclusively in Portuguese (pt-BR).
Implement JWT-based authentication flow for members and admin.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily customized with the Organic & Earthy palette. Strip away any default 'Vercel/SaaS' look.
For the 'Orando por você' feature, create an optimistic UI update (increment counter immediately) while saving to backend.
In the Admin panel, implement tabs or a sidebar to separate: Aprovação de Posts, Gestão de Eventos, Gestão de Contribuições, and Sugestões de Eventos.
The Contributions feature requires both an informational display (PIX/Bank details) and a functional form for users to log their manual offerings/tithes for record-keeping.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (e.g., 'Chave PIX copiada', 'Oração enviada', 'Post aprovado').
Ensure the Church Agenda allows members to view upcoming events and includes a button/modal for them to suggest new events to the admin.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx or equivalent.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
